title: Weak continuity of f(v_j)·(Jacobian minor of v_j) against L¹ weights, for continuous compactly supported f
statement: Let m, p, r ∈ ℕ and L ≥ 0. Let v_j, v₀ : ℝ^m → ℝ^p (j ∈ ℕ) be L-Lipschitz maps with v_j → v₀ uniformly on ℝ^m. Let a : Fin r → Fin p and b : Fin r → Fin m, let w ∈ L¹(ℝ^m) (Lebesgue), and let f : ℝ^p → ℝ be continuous with compact support. For a map v put M(v)(u) := det((Dv(u)e_{b(t)})_{a(s)})_{s,t ∈ Fin r}, with Dv(u) := fderiv ℝ v u and e_t := EuclideanSpace.single t 1. Then ∫ w(u)·(f(v_j(u))·M(v_j)(u)) du → ∫ w(u)·(f(v₀(u))·M(v₀)(u)) du as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (m p r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (v : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid p) (v₀ : Euclid m → Euclid p) (a : Fin r → Fin p) (b : Fin r → Fin m) (w : Euclid m → ℝ) (f : Euclid p → ℝ), (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (v j)) → LipschitzWith L v₀ → TendstoUniformly v v₀ atTop → Integrable w → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ u, w u * (f (v j u) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ (v j) u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s)))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ u, w u * (f (v₀ u) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ v₀ u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s)))))
